data.general: You may face challenges in daily routine due to Sun in 6th house and Rahu in 1st house, leading to increased stress and anxiety. Focus on maintaining a healthy work-life balance. With Moon in 4th house, you may feel emotionally connected to your family and home.
data.luck: Your luck may fluctuate due to Mars in 5th house, bringing short-term opportunities but also potential risks. Be cautious and strategic in your decisions. Moon in 4th house suggests a supportive family environment, which can contribute to your overall luck.
data.scope: This period may witness a shift in your professional scope, as Sun in 6th house indicates a need for change or adaptation. With Jupiter in 6th house, you may receive new opportunities or guidance that can help you grow professionally. However, Rahu in 1st house suggests that you may need to navigate uncharted territory.
data.study: You may experience a surge in mental activity and curiosity, thanks to Mercury in 6th house. This can be beneficial for learning and personal growth. However, Mars in 5th house may indicate a need for discipline and focus in your studies.
data.love: With Venus in 8th house, your love life may be intense and passionate, but also potentially complicated. Be honest and open with your partner to build trust and intimacy. Moon in 4th house suggests that you may value emotional connection and stability in your relationships.
data.travel: You may have a strong desire to travel or explore new places, thanks to Mars in 5th house. However, Saturn in 2nd house may indicate financial constraints or caution when it comes to spending money on travel. Plan carefully and consider budget-friendly options.
